what_happened: The person running Athena (an agent) saw two planner requests marked "interrupted" in athena status after they were held for low disk. It took them for lost, so it re-queued them, once with a retry and once as a fresh ask. The drain had left the held items queued and said so in its "left queued" note, which the agent did not read. The result was duplicate queue items, and the agent closed the duplicates. No job work was judged.
cause: A person or agent acts on or reports about state without resolving what it refers to, and Athena does not guard it. Here the state was whether a held item was lost or still queued. Athena's status shows "interrupted" for held items without saying that the drain keeps them queued. It also does not stop or flag a retry or new ask for an item that is already queued. The only guard is the agent's own habit of reading the full status output first.
other_causes: Athena's status wording for a held-for-low-disk item suggests loss. 'Interrupted' is also used for work that really was killed.
The agent acted on one word and skipped the 'left queued' note next to it.
open_hypotheses: The input does not show whether athena retry or a fresh ask warns when an equivalent item is already queued. If a warning existed, the agent may have ignored it.
The input does not show whether the held items were still queued at the moment of re-queuing, or were re-queued before the drain's note appeared.
prevention: Add a code check in retry and in new-request queuing. If a queued or held item already has the same request text or the same origin job, refuse, or warn and name that item with its state. Also make athena status label held-for-low-disk items as "held, still queued, drain will pick up" rather than "interrupted". With either change the agent would have seen the item was queued before it made a duplicate.
proposed_request: Make Athena refuse to create duplicate queue items. (1) When `athena retry` or a new request is submitted and a queued or held item already exists with the same request text or the same origin job, refuse and print that item's id and state. Add an explicit flag to override. (2) In `athena status`, show items held by the drain for low disk as "held: still queued, the drain will retry" and keep "interrupted" only for runs that were killed. Acceptance: a test queues an item, holds it for low disk, then runs retry on it and checks that the retry is refused and names the existing item. A second test checks that status prints the held wording. Add the CHANGELOG.md entry.
